name: Facebook Private Cleaner
description: Proof of concept: scans the Facebook Activity Log, loads older entries by scrolling, classifies post audiences, and can move one, a hand-picked batch of up to 20, or a planned queue of such batches (one at a time, each confirmed, or a run of the remaining batches approved once), Only-me posts to Trash after confirmation. A guided mode chains these steps behind one final approval.
